usedFor: Dynamic Mockups produces product images, and “Create Mockup Render” returns an image URL from a mockup template and your design.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Mockup Render” in Dynamic Mockups
bestTemplate.why: The action renders your design onto a mockup template and returns an image URL you can use right away.

watchOut: “Create Mockup Render” needs a mockup template and a design asset, so check both are chosen before it runs.
